pictures.author: Olaf Tausch
pictures.observations: Complete960x719 photo viewed: open roofless pit, two rows of massive plain square worn piers, incomplete longitudinal lintels/large fractured cap blocks, coursed perimeter wall with rectangular dark door recesses and green flooded floor. A timber stair/bridge descends from the side. No complete hall roof. High water partly covers central floor; condition varies from the second picture.

pictures.observations: Complete960x637 oblique: massive worn granite square piers, separate lintels with fractured profiles, lower molded bases, dark perimeter doorways and large coursed stone wall blocks. Low green water channels leave a wet central island and a small rectangular floor depression exposed. Loose stone fragments on rim. No intact ancient full roof or copied relief program.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Standing Osireion open megalithic hall/excavation: two rows of five massive plain square granite piers with worn bases/fractured surviving heights, incomplete longitudinal lintels and loose cap blocks. Coursed perimeter masonry with recessed rectangular door/niche bays, exposed central wet stone island/rectangular floor recesses and shallow opaque green-water moat in the pictured low-water state. Narrow timber side stair/bridge with simple rails. Complete opaque excavation floor and fitted retaining/earth rim meet a bounded mapped ground opening. No intact ancient roof, covered underground rooms/long passage, copied relief/graffiti or neighboring Seti I temple reconstruction.
